questionTextRaw:
Consider the following C program: #include <stdio.h> typedef struct { char *a; char *b; } t; void f1 (t s); void f2 (t *p); main() { static t s = {"A", "B"}; printf ("%s %s
", s.a, s.b); f1(s); printf ("%s %s
", s.a, s.b); f2(&s); } void f1 (t s) { s.a = "U"; s.b = "V"; printf ("%s %s
", s.a, s.b); return; } void f2(t *p) { p -> a = "V"; p -> b = "W"; printf("%s %s
", p -> a, p -> b); return; } What is the output generated by the program ? A.                                                                             B. C.                                                                             D.
